verdict.rationale: Skills are installed as ordinary, readable files you own, and the catalog gives each skill a one-line description of what it does. SKILL.md descriptions spell out when to use them: grilling says "Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking" and setup says "Run once before first use." Skills are invoked via slash commands, nothing updates behind your back, and a skill-finder skill helps pick the right one, all of which makes behavior predictable. Missing for 10: evidence that every one of the 25 skills carries an explicit activation/trigger description (only a couple are shown), documentation of auto-activation vs. manual invocation rules, and independent hands-on corroboration.
